design.decoder: Fit the principal I/Q axis and a two-centroid threshold on calibration only. Reuse them unchanged.
design.windowSelection: Use disjoint contiguous windows from sample zero at each horizon and condition on the first decoded level.

qualification.selection: Advance one documented plunger row from row 74, use the first repeat for calibration, and hold the next two for scoring. Select by acquisition metadata alone.
qualification.criterion: Qualify each observable and starting label separately only if all four grids meet the one-percentage-point cutoff on both score repeats. This is the previous point-error rule applied to a distinct setting on the same device.
